heading: INT. FLOODED COMMAND DUGOUT, WESTERN FRONT - DAWN, 1917

units.text: INT. FLOODED COMMAND DUGOUT, WESTERN FRONT - DAWN, 1917
Timber props.
Water to the ankles.
A field telephone dangles from a nail.
Shells rumble, miles off.
MAJOR ALISTAIR PEMBROKE-HUNT (40s, immaculate despite the mud, pipe unlit) sits at a map table.
Across from him, LIEUTENANT SAMUEL ODUYA (20s, shaking hands, cracked spectacles) stands at attention.
In the corner, SERGEANT DESMOND ARCHIBALD (50s, scarred jaw, rifle across his lap) polishes a bayonet.
Sit, Lieutenant.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: I'll stand, sir.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: Sit.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Oduya sits.
The water around his boots ripples.
At six o'clock, you'll take your platoon over the top.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Sir, the wire isn't cut.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: It will be.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Sir, with respect, the artillery has been wrong three days running.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: Lieutenant, I did not ask for a critique.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: No, sir. But my men will ask me why. And I won't have an answer.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: Tell them it's an order, lad. It's the only answer anyone's got.
units.name: ARCHIBALD

units.text: Thank you, Sergeant.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Don't thank me, sir. I'm only telling the boy what I told the last one.
units.name: ARCHIBALD

units.text: Pembroke-Hunt sets down his pencil.
For a long moment, the only sound is dripping.
Lieutenant Oduya. Do you have family?
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: A mother, sir. In Lagos. And a fiancee in Kent.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: Write to them now. I'll see the letters go out whatever happens.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Thank you, sir.
units.name: ODUYA

units.text: That's all.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT

units.text: Oduya rises, salutes, and wades toward the ladder.
Archibald watches him go, then turns to the Major.
You'll be writing his, sir?
units.name: ARCHIBALD

units.text: I always do.
units.name: PEMBROKE-HUNT
